settingsTour.apply.title: Save & Apply
settingsTour.apply.desc: Save Draft persists your changes; Apply activates them right away. Both controls live in the top toolbar, always within reach.
settings.configNote: Save Draft persists all profiles to model_catalog.json, which KAGWeb reads at runtime. Apply activates the selected profile and refreshes runtime clients. You can keep multiple profiles in the catalog and switch between them anytime.

codebuddy.auth.title: CodeBuddy account
codebuddy.auth.description: Uses the CodeBuddy login stored on this machine. No API key is sent to KAGWeb.
codebuddy.auth.logoutExternal: This session belongs to the CodeBuddy IDE plugin or CLI. Sign out there to disconnect it.
codebuddy.auth.sdkMissing: Sign in with the CodeBuddy IDE plugin or run `codebuddy` and enter /login — KAGWeb reuses that session. For in-app login instead: python -m pip install codebuddy-agent-sdk
codebuddy.auth.cliMissing: Install the CodeBuddy CLI before signing in.
codebuddy.auth.timeout: CodeBuddy login timed out. Try again.
codebuddy.auth.failed: Could not check or start CodeBuddy login.
codex.oauth.title: OpenAI Codex OAuth
codex.oauth.experimental: Experimental connection: the upstream Codex compatibility surface may change.
codex.oauth.isolated: Credentials are stored only by KAGWeb. This does not read or modify your Codex CLI login.
codex.oauth.ownerBound: Signs in with your own ChatGPT plan. It stays with your account and is never shared with other users of this deployment.
codex.oauth.localOnly: Local access opens authorization directly. Remote access first shows an SSH tunnel command.
codex.oauth.remoteSteps: First run the command below and keep the SSH tunnel running. Then click Open authorization.
codex.oauth.copyFailed: Could not copy the SSH tunnel command.
codex.oauth.callbackMissing: The KAGWeb server did not receive the OAuth callback on localhost:{{port}}. For a remote deployment, keep the SSH tunnel running and try again.
codex.oauth.callbackMissingUnknown: The KAGWeb server did not receive the OAuth callback. Start the login again and follow the authorization instructions shown for the new attempt.
codex.oauth.callbackUnavailable: KAGWeb cannot listen on either localhost:1455 or localhost:1457. Free one of these ports and try again.
codex.oauth.invalidResponse: The KAGWeb OAuth endpoint returned an unexpected response. Check that the reverse proxy forwards /api/settings/providers/openai-codex/ correctly.
codex.oauth.activated: Codex is connected and now the active model.
codex.oauth.reloadDeferred: Codex is connected. Apply your pending changes to see its models in the list.
codex.oauth.catalogFailed: The Codex model catalog could not be refreshed. Your login and current model were retained.
codex.oauth.inferenceActive: Wait for the active Codex response to finish before signing out.
codex.oauth.expired: Codex sign-in expired. Start it again.
codex.oauth.requestFailed: The Codex request failed. Try again.
codex.oauth.reasoningDescription: Choose a default for each Codex model. Only levels supported by that model are available.
codex.oauth.reasoningUnsupported: That reasoning effort is no longer supported. Refresh models and choose again.
codex.oauth.reasoningCatalogChanged: The Codex model list changed. Refresh models and try again.

mcp.refusal.stdioNotAllowed: A server you add yourself has to be a remote URL. Local commands run on the host, so only an administrator can add them.
mcp.refusal.blockedUrl: That address is not allowed. Use a public https URL for the MCP server.
mcp.refusal.nameReserved: That name belongs to a deployment server. Install it under a different name.
mcp.refusal.tooManyServers: You have reached your MCP server limit. Remove one first.
mcp.refusal.missingCredential: A required credential is missing. Fill in every required field, then try again.
mcp.refusal.entryAdminOnly: This service runs as a local command, so only an administrator can add it.
